title: The Value of Plant Disease Early-Warning Systems: A Case Study of USDA's Soybean Rust Coordinated Framework
authors: Michael J. Roberts; David Schimmelpfennig; Elizabeth Ashley; Michael Livingston; Mark Ash; Utpal Vasavada
evidence_kind: expected value of information method and numeric examples
extracted_values: Framework estimated producer-profit gain $11-$299 million in 2005 or $0.16-$4.12/acre, with framework cost $2.6M to almost $5M; strategies include preventive, monitor/curative, and no management; no-info EV is max over strategies under prior infection probability P; with signal, high-risk probability b, low-risk probability g, signal probability a, and P=a*b+(1-a)*g; quality f maps to b=f(1-P)+P and g=P(1-f); Appendix example P=0.60, f=0.8 gives no-info EV 92366, with-info EV 97098, value 4731/farm or 6.38/acre
model_use: method benchmark for future probabilistic VOI layer: E[cost_without_information]-E[cost_with_information]
notes: Not nematode-specific but directly relevant to early-warning value and signal quality
